summary: Master Windows Server 2022 with our comprehensive administration training. Enhance your skills and boost your career with expert-led courses and resources.
lede: Windows Server 2022 administration covers configuring server roles and services, managing identities and access, and supporting workloads. For intermediate administrators and infrastructure professionals, the course provides structured practice with Active Directory, DNS and DHCP troubleshooting, and Group Policy and NTFS permissions. You also work with PowerShell automation, Hyper-V, updates, event logs, and backup and recovery procedures in a controlled lab.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who support Windows Server 2022 administration across identity, infrastructure, security, and service operations. It targets intermediate practitioners who can navigate Windows environments and need structured practice with server roles, troubleshooting, and automation.
outcomes: Group Policy And NTFS Permissions Design
modules: Group Policy and Windows Access Control
Windows Server Security Backup and Updates
prerequisites: You should have practical experience using Windows desktop or server environments, basic TCP/IP networking knowledge, and familiarity with user accounts, file permissions, and command-line navigation. Previous exposure to Active Directory or Windows Server is helpful but not essential for every module. No programming background is required, and you will use PowerShell for guided administration rather than software development. Advanced topics such as Failover Clustering, hybrid identity, and automation design receive operational application coverage, while production-grade engineering remains outside this five-day scope. Bring a laptop if your delivery arrangement supports a virtual lab. TrainingCred should confirm lab access, supplied datasets, and software setup during course planning.
